title: Ottawa - Taste of Canada Food Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Eat your way across Canada—without leaving downtown Ottawa!

Join us on the TASTE OF CANADA tour for a fun and flavour-packed journey through the dishes that Canada has popularized. Come hungry—and leave with a new appreciation for Canada’s quirky culinary inventions!

The Taste of Canada Food Tour is a guided gastronomic experience that brings iconic Canadian dishes to life through delicious tastings, fun storytelling, and local insight.
Over the course of 2 – 2.5 hours, you’ll visit a variety of handpicked spots in the heart of Ottawa’s historic ByWard Market, sampling dishes and drinks that highlight Canadian comfort foods, regional favourites, and uniquely Canadian inventions.

Along the way, your guide will share the history, quirks, and cultural significance behind each bite.
WHAT YOU WILL TASTE:
– A classic Hawaiian pizza slice paired with a Bloody Caesar cocktail*
– Authentic Quebec-style poutine served with local,
Canadian craft beer and many more!
